classification_rules.U: PowerRed=0, active, exact one-minute continuity, PowerRef>=95% rated
classification_rules.R: PowerRed>0, active, exact one-minute continuity, PowerRef<95% rated, power tracks PowerRef within 8%+20kW, wind>5m/s
classification_rules.I: PowerRed>0 and active but the right-censoring binding condition is not secure

semisynthetic_protocol.base_records: all eligible U records in continuous segments of at least 60 min
semisynthetic_protocol.shared_event_mask: S1-S4 use identical policy_active/event_id generated from EVENT_SEED; S4 cap depths come from the independent CAP_SEED stream; verified element-wise before writing the summary
semisynthetic_protocol.censoring_semantics: right-censored when policy_active and A_true >= C_syn
semisynthetic_protocol.fixed_and_random_caps: 120-min persistent non-overlapping events; random caps are constant within event
semisynthetic_protocol.primary_predictors: power, wind, cap, and censoring flag; pitch and generator speed are excluded from the primary model
